subject: general
question: Two successive discounts of 5% and 12% are offered on the sale of an article whose marked price is Rs. 1,500. The selling price of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the article = Rs. 1,500

First discount = 5%

Second discount = 12%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)

**Calculation:**

First Discount = 5% = 5/100 = 0.05

Second Discount = 12% = 12/100 = 0.12

Selling Price = 1,500 × (1 - 0.05) × (1 - 0.12)

Selling Price = 1,500 × 0.95 × 0.88

Selling Price = 1,500 × 0.836

Selling Price = 1,254

**The selling price of the article is Rs. 1,254.**
